posts.tagline: From video to publish-ready AI subtitles—all in one browser
posts.description: Free: 60 one-minute videos a month, no signup. Drop in a video and generate, fix, translate, style and export subtitles in one editor. All 30 styles are included free. Most tools leave you hunting line by line—Fix flags uncertain words and counts down to “All clear,” a real finish line. Pro and Max add full-track translation, HD without a watermark, eight subtitle formats, custom fonts and saved brand styles. Your video stays in your browser.

posts.name: Maccess
posts.tagline: Your Mac, in your pocket — trackpad, screen, and AI
posts.description: Control your Mac from iPhone with touchpad, keyboard, screen mirroring, files, and Mackie AI. Pair over Wi-Fi or use Online Access from anywhere.

posts.name: AutoClaw
posts.tagline: An AI work agent across desktop, browser, and chat
posts.description: AutoClaw is a desktop AI agent for multi-step work across files, browsers, office documents, web apps, and IM. Give it a goal, let it operate tools and coordinate agents, then get the finished work back in the same conversation. GLM-5.3 is built in.

posts.name: Zero
posts.tagline: Vercel's programming language built for AI agents
posts.description: Zero is Vercel's experimental programming language designed for a world where AI agents write the code. Instead of editing source text, agents query and patch a semantic program graph while the compiler checks every change. Humans simply ask for outcomes, then review readable code projections when needed. Built from the ground up for agentic coding, with token efficiency, fast builds, low memory, and zero dependencies.

posts.name: Pawvis
posts.tagline: Control your Mac via camera & train gestures, local & FOSS
posts.description: PawVis turns your Mac’s webcam into a hand-tracked mouse, no extra hardware required. Raise your hand and the cursor follows, dip a finger to click, and fold two fingers to scroll. Map gestures to custom actions like window management or any app/command from a series of common gestures or train your own. Everything runs 100% on-device, and PawVis is free and open source. Enable optional voice control for hands-free commands, or pass computer-use tasks to Codex or Claude Code.

posts.name: Agents Never Sleep
posts.tagline: Agents keep running with the lid closed
posts.description: A macOS menu bar app that keeps your agents AI awake even if with lid closed. No more keeping your laptop half-open or carrying it around in weird ways. Stop this madness 🙅‍♂️, close the lid.

posts.name: KerasFormers
posts.tagline: Keras 3 collection of pretrained models
posts.description: Pretrained transformer models in pure Keras 3, runnable on JAX, PyTorch and TensorFlow.

posts.name: Port Radar for macOS
posts.tagline: An AI port manager for your Mac.
posts.description: Port Radar is a native macOS menu bar app that shows you exactly what’s running on your ports—in plain English. Spot Vite, Next.js, Docker, forgotten apps, and anything else quietly using resources, then stop it with a single click. Apple Intelligence answers "what is this, is it safe to stop?" right on your device, so nothing leaves your Mac. Plus one click Cloudflare tunnels to share a local site as a live link.

posts.name: Pocket by Meta
posts.tagline: Vibe-code games, then share them like TikToks
posts.description: Pocket is Meta's new social app for creating, playing, and remixing interactive experiences with AI. Describe an idea and turn it into a playable "gizmo" that can respond to touch, motion, sound, photos, and even your camera. Share it to the feed, play what others have imagined, or remix their creations into something new. It's vibe coding turned into a social experience—no coding required.

posts.name: VeloFiler
posts.tagline: Keyboard-first dual-pane file manager for macOS
posts.description: VeloFiler is a keyboard-first, dual-pane file manager for macOS, built in Rust on GPUI for instant startup and smooth rendering. Navigate with Vim-style keys, preview images, code, Markdown, PDF, video and Office documents without opening another app, and manage remote servers over SSH/SFTP right next to your local files. Stop clicking through folders — fly through them.

posts.name: Flappy Bid
posts.tagline: The leaderboard money can't buy
posts.description: Ad platforms sell the top spot to whoever pays most. FlappyBid gives it to whoever plays best. Enter your product, play Flappy Bird, unlimited runs. At 00:00 UTC the top product owns the whole site for 24h with a live click counter, then retires undefeated.

posts.name: roastme.gg
posts.tagline: Get roasted. Publicly.
posts.description: Pay to get publicly roasted by AI. Drop your X handle or a website, pick how hard it should hurt ($1 to a $1,000+ scorched-earth tier), and Claude writes a roast based on nothing but the name and the vibe it gives off, no bio, no posts, no scraping. Every roast lands on a public leaderboard ranked by price paid, with a shareable card for X.

posts.name: First Verse
posts.tagline: The best new poems, written by real people
posts.description: First Verse is the place to find the best new poems every day; written and read by real people. Post your own work, get popular poems in your inbox, and tip other poets.

posts.name: Cognitive Biases Academy
posts.tagline: Free, 66 languages, one goal: a billion self-aware minds
posts.description: Your brain misfires by design: 190+ ways, to be exact. Backed by 1,800+ academic references, translated into 66 languages, free forever, no card required. The mission: one billion people who can catch their own thinking going wrong. posts.name: VinVAI
posts.tagline: Install Vinv once, give coding agents a verification layer
posts.description: Vinv is an IDE plugin that auto-exposes its MCPs to all coding harnesses on your system. It gives harnesses the same runtime information and context about the repo you are working on, connects runtime traces to the source code, provides context for the coding agents, and reruns the code to verify that the fix works. It uses Thompson sampling to figure out how much runtime context to give the agent. Everything runs locally. Open source, Apache 2.0.
